facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission said on 2025-04-30 that Nigeria would host the Network of African Data Protection Authorities (NADPA) conference and annual general meeting in Abuja, expected 6-8 May 2025; the meeting is announced, not yet held, at the document's date.
